observations: Photo 0 shows a vintage-style manual sewing machine on a tiled floor.
The machine is beige/grey with a foot pedal and coiled power cord.
The machine has a needle, presser foot, and control dials, including a dial for stitch type and another for speed.
The machine appears used, with visible dirt and wear on the body and base.
The foot pedal is black with a textured surface and is connected to the machine via a black cord.
The background includes a yellow and white patterned object (possibly a bag or cushion) and part of a metal stand with wheels.

claims.claim: Ideal Topstar manual sewing machine available for sale.
claims.evidence: No photo shows this clearly enough to read.

risks.risk: The machine may not be functional or may have internal damage not visible in the photo.
risks.proof: A video showing the machine in operation, including the needle moving and the foot pedal triggering the mechanism.

risks.risk: The machine may have missing parts or damaged components (e.g., needle, presser foot, or internal gears).
risks.proof: Close-up photos of the needle, presser foot, and internal mechanism (if possible) to confirm they are intact and undamaged.
risks.if_unproven: priced as possibly incomplete or damaged

risks.risk: The power cord or foot pedal may be damaged or non-functional.
risks.proof: Close-up of the power cord and foot pedal, showing no fraying, cuts, or loose connections.

proof_requests: Video of the machine in operation, including the needle moving and foot pedal triggering.
Close-up photos of the needle, presser foot, and internal mechanism.
Close-up of the power cord and foot pedal to check for damage or loose connections.
response.reason: The item is known from the photos. What they cannot prove is priced at its worst case until the proof asked for below arrives.
